name: Camera locked off
text: The camera is locked off on a tripod and does not move.
desc: Denies the model a camera move without denying it motion. Use under a subject performance that must stay in one framing.
verdict: RENDERED 2026-08-04, 3 seeds. Motion 0.695/0.860/0.595 against an empty control of 0.628, creep 1.02/1.00/1.00, and the highest frame-to-frame correlation of any camera card. It genuinely holds the camera - and so does an empty string. The card is honest but it buys nothing over emitting nothing; keep it only as an explicit way to say 'no camera move' in an authored film. Band 0.406-0.744 (empty control 0.628); frame-scale ceiling 1.191.
